name: TiMO ODV
short: Co-founder. DJ, producer, singer and songwriter from Kempton Park.
bio:
TiMO ODV is a DJ, producer, singer and songwriter from Kempton Park on Johannesburg's East Rand, and co-founder of Midnight Children Records.

The label takes its name from his 2020 EP Midnight Children, made with Aidin Caye.

name: Aidin Caye
short: Co-founder. DJ and producer from the East Rand.
bio:
Aidin Caye is a DJ and producer from Johannesburg's East Rand and co-founder of Midnight Children Records.

He co-produced TiMO ODV's 2020 EP Midnight Children, the record the label is named after.

name: Andeon
short: DJ and producer from South Africa, on the label's first release with TiMO ODV.
bio:
Andeon is a DJ and producer from South Africa.

He features on What About Us? with TiMO ODV, the first release on Midnight Children Records.
